visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a main male character wearing glasses and a beige blazer over a black top, walking through a well-lit electronics showroom. He holds a single red rose and smiles directly into the camera; the background is filled with rows of TVs and appliances. (2) A scene cut shows a female character in an outdoor park setting with green trees and a grey pavement background. She wears a black dress over a white shirt and adjusts her hair while looking upwards; the lighting is natural and bright daylight. (3) Returning to the indoor store, the man is shown in a medium close-up, speaking expressively with significant hand gestures. The woman stands opposite him, looking skeptical or slightly annoyed, framed against the shelving units and price tags of the retail environment. (4) A large, stainless steel double-door refrigerator is showcased in a medium shot. Yellow and white text overlays appear on the screen, detailing the object's characteristics; the man is seen briefly leaning against the appliance while holding a microphone. (5) A white front-loading washing machine is displayed, with its door opening to reveal the internal drum. The camera zooms in slightly on the control panel and branding; the female character is shown in the background looking increasingly confused or disinterested. (6) The final phase features a rapid montage of the man gesturing towards a large TV screen and the store's exterior. A pink sign for '全國電子' is shown under a clear blue sky; bold, variety-style captions dominate the frame to signal a promotional event.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, high-arousal male vocal greeting the audience over an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM with a prominent kick drum. The vocal is crisp with high articulation clarity (4-5), delivered with a humorous and professional tone typical of a show host. (2) There is a transition to a natural outdoor acoustic environment with a subtle bird-chirping and distant traffic hum. A female voice with a moderate pitch and calm, friendly tone introduces herself; the BGM persists at a lower volume as a background bed. (3) An intentional 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition back to the studio/store environment. The male speaker returns with high intensity, while the BGM continues to provide a rhythmic backbone to the energetic dialogue between the two speakers. (4) A deep, processed male voice mimics a character, accompanied by a low-frequency electrical hum representing a refrigerator. A distinct mechanical 'thud' of a door closing or opening is heard, punctuating the narrative flow as the narrator describes the appliance's features. (5) The sound texture shifts to include sloshing water and a rhythmic mechanical whirring noise, simulating a washing machine in operation. The male narrator maintains a fast speech rate, delivering humorous personified descriptions while the BGM tempo remains steady and driving. (6) A high-impact 'ding' or 'impact' SFX triggers a final shift to a promotional tone. The male vocal reaches peak arousal and volume, shouting a call-to-action. The BGM swells in intensity, concluding with a loud, processed sound of a cheering crowd and a final stinger hit.

It attracts viewers with comedic sketches before pivoting to a high-energy sales pitch.
